note: P3749 (Pro 3:12) — the LORD reproves whom he loves; as a father the son he delights in. Divine love = arena (qualifier); the father's delight = the human char.

dims.v: delight — a father's pleasure in his son, the simile for God's love-discipline
a father delighting in his son, the human mirror of God's reproving love
coupled to the LORD's love (267517) as its human analogy

ratsah (be pleased with/delight in): the HUMAN paternal affect that the verse uses to illumine God's discipline. Screen 0 — the LORD's own 'love' (267517) is the divine arena (qualifier); the char here is the father's delight, a genuine human interior.
